title: OpenE906 (XUANTIE-RV/opene906)
_note: T-Head's XuanTie E906: the 32-bit RV32 embedded core -- ifu / idu / iu / lsu /
rtu / cp0, the FPU and its falu / fdsu / fmau datapaths, the CLIC and CLINT,
the PMP and PMU, the bus interface, the debug transport (tdt) and trace (dtu)
blocks -- plus the smart_run integration platform around it (AHB / APB
fabrics, UART, GPIO, timer, WIC, SMPU, memory).  The same vendor and the same
packaging as OpenC910, so the four facts the C910 manifest records apply here
unchanged, and all four were re-checked against THIS checkout rather than
assumed:
* The checked-in gen_rtl/filelists/E906_asic_rtl.fl is a flat list of 242
paths and needs no generation -- no FuseSoC, no Bender, no mill.
* FIVE define-only headers (cpu_cfig.h, pa_dtu_cfig.h, pa_idu_cfig.h,
tdt_define.h, sysmap.h) are compiled as SOURCES by that filelist and are
`include`d by no RTL file at all, so they are always_srcs -- and the
family must read `--single-unit`, because compiled as its own unit each a
file never sees the others' macros and read_slang stops at an unknown
macro, losing the REFERENCE for every row that uses one.  C910 needed two
such headers; E906 needs SIX, and the sixth is not in the same filelist:
tdt_dmi_define.h belongs to gen_rtl/filelists/tdt_dmi_top_rtl.fl, the
SEPARATE filelist for the DMI / DTM debug transport, and without it
tdt_dmi, tdt_dmi_top, tdt_dtm_idr and tdt_dtm_top stop at
`Unknown macro "TDT_DMI_IDLE_CYCLE"`.  Reading only the ASIC filelist
is not enough for this repository.
* gen_rtl/fpga/rtl is not an FPGA-only variant: it holds the 26
pa_f_spsram_* models (and fpga_ram) that the pa_spsram_* wrappers
instantiate unconditionally, which is why the ASIC filelist carries them.
They are always_srcs rather than rows -- a behavioural RAM is a library
cell, and as rows the C910 equivalents were all unprovable with clean
co-simulations and 0 undriven.
* tdt/rtl has common / debug / top subdirectories, so its glob is
recursive; the other units are flat.
pa_cpu_top_golden_port is NOT a row: it declares 105 ports and has ZERO
logic -- no `assign`, no `always`, nothing between the port list and
`endmodule`.  It is a port-list contract used for port comparison, so synth
yields an empty module and the miter reports `Can't find gold module \gold`.
That is a degenerate SOURCE module, not a reader defect, and measuring it
proves nothing either way.
smart_run/logical/tb is not a root (its three files are the testbench), which
is what smart_run/logical/filelists/smart.fl says too: it lists ahb, apb,
system, gpio, mem, pmu, smpu, uart, wic and timer as library directories and
not tb.
First local sweep 2026-10-28: 255 rows, **203 proven**, 255 / 255 elaborate,
**255 / 255 with 0 undriven**, 207 co-sim PASS, and **0 `read_uhdm`-only**
**co-sim divergences** -- the one divergence in the family is SHARED
(pa_spsram_1024x4, 30 cycles on read_uhdm and read_slang alike).  What is
left is 50 SAT-budget rows (the memory controllers, the 33x33 multiplier
partial product, the openE906 and soc tops, the sysmap) and TWO formal-only
`differs` leads, gpio and pmu, each with a co-sim PASS whose stimulus reached
only 2 ACTIVE CYCLES -- an APB register block barely moves under random
input, so those PASSes carry almost no weight and the `differs` is the only
real signal on them.  They are the family's open queue.
